verdict.rationale: stagewise has no documented region or residency selector. It offers indirect ways to control where data goes: local models via Ollama or LM Studio with "zero external API calls", full BYOK so "no requests go through the stagewise managed service", custom endpoints such as Azure OpenAI, Bedrock and Vertex AI, and optional enterprise self-hosting of the stagewise Cloud. A community user also noted that the dataflow (what is sent to the LLM) is not documented. Missing for 10: an explicit region or residency choice for the managed stagewise Account/Cloud, documentation of where stagewise stores user data, a dataflow and residency explanation, and independent corroboration.
